title: Hairaan na ho Sughra mein Zainab haan
body:
Hairaan na ho Sughra mein Zainab haan.
Haaye O’ mein Zainab haan.
Maynou maar ditta tayray piyu day dardaan.
1) Hoye wayn baday Sughra tayra naalay kay (x2)
Haaye tayra naalay kay
Jadoon tauraya maqtal nou tayra veer jawaan.
2) Aynaa ujrdhay gharaan under kadi wasda si (x2)
Haaye kadi wasda si
Jaynoy luttaya wich Karbal kul musalmanaan.
3) Bay misal shahadat si tayray Asghar di (x2)
Haaye tayray Asghar di.
Jidday qatal uttay roya khud teer kamaan.
4) Gal Awn-o-Muhammad di na poch maytoun (x2)
Haaye na poch maytoun
Shabbir da ban sadqa ho gaye qurbaan.
5) Safaraan wich rondi rayee rajj babal nou (x2)
Haaye o’ rajj babal nou
Aayee maut Sakina nou ja wich zindaan.
6) Darbaar thayee paeshi tayri phophiyaan di (x2)
Haaye o’ tayri phophiyaan di
Raya saangh tay haaye parhda Shabbir Quraan.
7) Gal Awn-o-Muhammad di na poch maytoun (x2)
Haaye na poch maytoun
Shabbir da ban sadqa ho gaye qurbaan.
8) Keetay safar rakou under mayray Abid nay (x2)
Haaye mayray Abid nay
Beemar di akhiaan chou’n raya khoon rawaan.
9) Hun hasrat ay Bibi ayhoo Adil di (x2)
Haaye ayhoo Adil di
Tayri turbat waykhan layee kadi Shaam nou ja an.
